gaps.sentence: The fire blew ___ the gas cylinder exploded.
gaps.explanation: blow up = explode, or make something explode.

gaps.sentence: They live ___ their pension and a small rent.
gaps.explanation: live off = have as income/food; live on = have as income (money).
bring down = cause a government/person to lose power; reduce (prices).

gaps.sentence: Several runners passed ___ in the heat.
The flood wiped ___ the entire harvest.
The bonus made up ___ all the overtime we had done.
gaps.explanation: make up FOR something = compensate for it.

gaps.sentence: Please hand ___ your essays by Friday.
gaps.hint: give to a person in authority
gaps.explanation: hand in = give work/documents to somebody in authority.

gaps.sentence: The band broke ___ in the middle of the song.
